Bachao Guide

⚠ Abhi scam ho gaya? Foran yeh karein
  1. Neeche is website par report submit karein taake dusre log is number se bach sakein.
Fake Bank / Phone Call Scams▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • Koi call kar ke khud ko bank officer, State Bank, ya "security department" batata hai.
  • Kehta hai aapka account block ho raha hai ya "verification" ke liye OTP chahiye.

Kabhi na karein

  • Kabhi bhi phone par OTP, PIN, ya CVV kisi ko na batayein — bank kabhi yeh nahi mangta.
  • Kisi bhi link par click karke apni banking details na daalein.

Kya karein

  • Call turant kaat dein aur bank ki official helpline se khud call karein confirm karne ke liye.
Online Work / Job Offer Scams▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • WhatsApp par "ghar baithe kamayein" ka message aata hai — task complete karke paise milne ka wada.
  • Shuru mein chhoti payment bhi mil jati hai, phir "advance deposit" mangi jati hai.

Kabhi na karein

  • Kisi bhi job ke liye pehle paise (registration, training fee, deposit) kabhi na dein.

Kya karein

  • Company ka naam, website, aur registration khud verify karein.
  • Agar sirf WhatsApp par baat ho rahi hai aur koi office/interview nahi, to shak karein.
Investment Schemes▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • "Double your money in 1 month" ya guaranteed high returns ka wada kiya jata hai.
  • Forex, crypto, ya stock trading groups mein invite kiya jata hai.

Kabhi na karein

  • Koi bhi scheme jo "guaranteed" ya "risk-free" high return ka wada kare, us par bharosa na karein.

Kya karein

  • Sirf SECP se licensed companies mein hi invest karein, aur khud verify karein.
SMS / WhatsApp Suspicious Links▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • "Aapka parcel arrive nahi hua", "prize jeeta hai" jaisa message mile aur link click karne ko kaha jaye.

Kabhi na karein

  • Unknown number se aane wale link par kabhi click na karein, khaas kar agar wo login mange.

Kya karein

  • Number ko pehle is website par check karein, aur message ko report/delete kar dein.
Fake Online Sellers▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • Social media par sasta product dikha kar advance payment mangi jati hai, phir seller ghayab ho jata hai.

Kabhi na karein

  • Naye/anjaan sellers ko poori payment advance mein na karein.

Kya karein

  • Jahan mumkin ho, cash on delivery use karein, aur seller ke pichle reviews/reports check karein.
Loan Fraud Calls▾

Yeh kaise hota hai

  • "Bina documents ke instant loan" ka offer aata hai, phir "processing fee" advance mangi jati hai.

Kabhi na karein

  • Loan lene se pehle koi bhi fee advance mein na dein.

Kya karein

  • Sirf State Bank se licensed banks/companies se hi loan lein.
